channels.name: distance
channels.description: Unmodified proximity query distance; -1 means no hit within 0.1 m.

channels.name: normal_force
channels.description: Norm of the sum of all pad normal-force vectors, after independent Gaussian noise on its three components.

channels.name: tangential_force
channels.description: Norm of the sum of all pad tangential-force vectors, after independent Gaussian noise on its three components.

channels.name: direction
channels.description: atan2 of the noisy total tangent Y and X components in range_frame, wrapped into [0, 2*pi); zero XY vector gives zero.

channels.name: capacitance
channels.description: Educational linear toy response: capacitance_base + capacitance_gain * norm(pad normal sum + pad tangent sum). Arbitrary raw values, not SI capacitance or a calibrated product model; no added noise.
